dashboard.noProgressYet: Start your journey with Phase 1 to begin collecting real transport data.

phase1.title: Phase 1 — Data Exploration & Project Foundations
phase1.description: Understand the problem, inspect Infranode APIs, understand JSON structures, set up Python and VS Code.

phase2.title: Phase 2 — Python & API Data Collection
phase2.description: Build an automated, robust data collection pipeline collecting weather and live transport departures.

phase3.title: Phase 3 — Pandas, Data Cleaning & Engineering
phase3.description: Parse raw JSON, clean missing values, handle timestamps, join datasets, and engineer analytical features.

phase4.title: Phase 4 — Exploratory Data Analysis & Statistics
phase4.description: Statistical distributions, delay variance, city rankings, time-series patterns, and Matplotlib/Seaborn visualization.

phase5.title: Phase 5 — SQL & Relational Databases
phase5.description: Relational schemas, SQLite/PostgreSQL, joins, aggregations, CTEs, and advanced window functions (RANK, LAG/LEAD).

phase6.title: Phase 6 — Excel for Professional Analysis
phase6.description: Excel Tables, XLOOKUP, dynamic formulas, multi-dimensional PivotTables, Slicers, and executive reporting.

phase7.title: Phase 7 — Power BI & Business Intelligence
phase7.description: Star schema modeling, DAX measures (CALCULATE, time intelligence), and interactive portfolio dashboards.

phase8.title: Phase 8 — Machine Learning: Delay Prediction
phase8.description: Supervised regression, chronological train/test splitting, baseline comparisons, Random Forest, and limitation audits.
